final_claim: For the canonical six-point minimal finite 2-sphere X2 and four-point minimal finite circle X1, Map(X2,X1) has exactly 44 points and strongly deformation retracts through 40 beat-point deletions to the four constant maps, so its Stong core is X1 and its order complex has homotopy type S1.
